text: Hino jeyaa fahin e maandeeji Alla mawɗi tinndinay- ɗi kattal e gootaaku Makko, wonnde O taganii on, onon worɓe ɓen, immorde e noone mon, resondir- ɓe, fii yo on deeƴir e maɓɓe tawde ko on noone gooto, O waɗi hakkunde mon giggol e yurmeende. Wonii e ko jantaa koo, hujjaaji ɓannguɗi wonannde yimɓe miijitotooɓe, tawde ko kamɓe nafitorta gollitirgol haqqil.
